steps: When publication is authorized, sign in to the intended KDE Store/OpenDesktop account in a normal browser. This preparation kit does not authenticate or submit anything.

Open the existing Krema listing at submission.entry_url and compare its displayed version and source download with {{version}} and {{source_filename}}. If the listing already shows {{version}} with a source file whose SHA-256 matches, the update is already published; stop without re-uploading. Otherwise update its version to {{version}} and review the prepared metadata against the available authenticated controls. Do not create a duplicate listing. The KDE Store/OpenDesktop/Pling OCS mirrors use this same content record, so update the canonical listing once and verify the mirrors afterward.

Paste the complete contents of kde-store.txt into the listing description. Keep the standalone-application and Wayland-only wording, package links, source-build links, and warning that Krema is not a Plasmoid or widget.

Review the existing logo, banner, and screenshot gallery. Update media where needed with krema-kde-store-logo.png, krema-kde-store-banner.png, krema-dock-zoom.png, krema-dock-overview.png, and krema-settings.png, using each media entry's caption and alt text where controls are available; avoid duplicate images.

Update the current source download with {{source_filename}}. Use the label 'Krema {{version}} source code (tarball, requires compilation)' and verify the SHA-256 value {{source_sha256}} before accepting the upload. Do not upload a fake binary, installer, widget, or Plasmoid archive.

Review the rendered listing, category, version, links, captions, alt text, and source-file label. Stop before the final publish or submit action until the maintainer explicitly authorizes publication.

evidence_notes: The public Krema listing exists at https://store.kde.org/p/2376676; it showed v0.9.0 when the v0.10.0 packet was first prepared. Each packet prepares an update of this listing to the target release, not a new listing.

The KDE Store/OpenDesktop/Pling frontends expose the same OCS content record #2376676; after updating the canonical listing, verify the mirrored record and public pages. linux-apps.org is an additional OCS frontend; linux-apps.com is unrelated.

The verified Crystal Dock peer record uses system-style tags including plasma##majorversion=6 and original-product. Those peer tags are evidence for the category and product type, not claims about private KDE Store form controls for Krema.
limitations: The authenticated KDE Store/OpenDesktop form was not inspected. Private field labels, character bounds, upload limits, and required-field behavior are not asserted; fields contains the final values to map to the corresponding controls.
Preparing this kit does not authenticate, upload, or update the existing KDE Store listing or its mirrors. Final submission or publication requires maintainer action.
The staged download is a genuine {{tag}} source archive and requires a local CMake/C++23 build. No binary package or Plasmoid is represented as a KDE Store download.
Distro package links are public external installation channels and are included in the description; they are not substituted for the source archive upload.
The supplied media are repository PNG assets for staging. The update's final rendering, moderation, mirror propagation, and publication remain unverified.
